Name: Milk the Villagers' Artisan Goods
Author: whyamIlikethiswhy
Description:
Adds vegan dairy and non-dairy options, ingredients kindly donated by the villagers of Stardew Valley. 18+ Only.


Future Additions:
-All female characters' Real Vegan Butter
-[s]All female characters' Clotted Cream
[/s]-[s]Character specific lines in description[/s]
-Why I'm going to hell.
-Mail Framework Mod for Clotted Cream Recipes









Icon base modified from and inspired by Raffadax Complete Production by Raffadax.
Inspired by Milk the Villagers by Trunip190. Thanks for the great mod.
Thanks to Pathoschild, Spacechase0, and Digus for their framework mods.
And many, many thanks to ConcernedApe for creating the game and their artwork.
